description_en: The DescribeDBClusterConfig operation queries the parameter configuration of a community-compatible ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterConfig接口查询社区兼容版集群的参数配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-db-cluster-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-wz988vja2mor40000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterConfig

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
